# Markset

PDF markup, measuring and sheet management for architects and expert witnesses.
Simple, fast, and priced for the solo professional.

Markset is a modified version of [Open PDF Studio](https://github.com/OpenAEC-Foundation/open-pdf-studio)
by the OpenAEC Foundation, licensed under the LGPL-3.0. See [NOTICE.md](../NOTICE.md)
for details and [FORK-NOTES.md](../open-pdf-studio/markset/FORK-NOTES.md) for what
Markset changes.

- Website: https://usemarkset.com
- Status: early development, not yet released

The upstream project's README is at [README.md](../README.md).
